memory_paths.composition: Choose one full-path ready time for a load. Do not add L1+L2+DRAM. Unknown cache outcomes may be separate finite residency scenarios; do not fit miss fractions to solver time.
memory_paths.l2_issue_missing: RTX4090 Table5 whole-device1622.2 scalar/1708.0 vector bytes per clock does not identify AD104 L2 issue capacity or per-SM share; do not divide bySM count or cache size without a new topology hypothesis.
memory_paths.store_downstream: Verified local33 L1-hit stores still produce downstream L2 traffic. Local33/local257 L2 hit+miss counters sometimes fail conservation; no fitted residual correction or exact L2 service inferred.

same_cell_store_load_motifs.qualification: Whole observed serialized store/load pair interval with recurring administration under exact recorded native forms. Transfer to a source-identified same-cell motif is nominal only. Includes read result availability and store/load ordering; not standalone store latency.
same_cell_store_load_motifs.composition: For an explicitly contracted matching motif reserve both memory issue demands and set motif dependent completion from motif entry using pair interval. Do not also add individual LDS/LDL latency, loop administration, or pair-minus-load as store latency. A general separated store/load edge needs an additional spacing/queue model; the interval is not a measured arbitrary-gap store-to-load constraint.
same_cell_store_load_motifs.store_drain_missing: No independent source-register release or final outstanding-store completion value.

control_motif.qualification: Six matching same-target recurring loops, roughly3.00195 counter cycles per iteration; includes endpoint frequency. Metric is a stalled-warp-cycle normalization, not isolated BRA service latency or necessarily additive elapsed time. Use only as a motif sensitivity; do not charge every source conditional branch this number.

instruction_delivery.observation: Actual131184-byte hot body is a residency-dependent transition:8-capacity-warps throughput deteriorates immediately above it;16-capacity-warps retains gentler slope up to147568bytes.
instruction_delivery.composition: Use physical footprint/residency warning or explicit calibrated microbenchmark scenario with native-shape transfer. No universal128KiB hard cutoff, byte-linear penalty, or addition of total fetch cycles to overlapping arithmetic.
